name: scryguard
description: A trust gate for pull requests written by AI coding agents

scripts.openapi:check: pnpm openapi:generate && { git diff --exit-code -- apps/api/openapi.json && git ls-files --error-unmatch apps/api/openapi.json > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'apps/api/openapi.json is stale or untracked: run pnpm openapi:generate and commit it' >&2; exit 1; }; }
scripts.test:stack: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml --env-file .env.test up -d --wait && pnpm db:migrate:test
scripts.validate: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm openapi:check && pnpm test && pnpm build

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: if [ -x .git/local-pre-commit ]; then .git/local-pre-commit || exit 1; fi; pnpm exec lint-staged
